Name: Sweet Gem Berry Extended - English Translation
Author: Arillume
Description:
This is an English translation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25390]Sweet Gem Berry Extend[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Skeleton0w0/about-me?gameId=1303]Skeleton0w0[/url]﻿

Adds the following functions to these machines:
[code]﻿[spoiler]Preserves Jar: Add a sweet gem berry to produce Sweet Gem Jelly,
Keg: By adding either coffee or tea to a keg with at least one sweet gem berry in your inventory will produce either Sweet Gem Coffee or Sweet Gem Tea,
Dehydrator: Adding a sweet gem berry will produce 60-70 sugar.

Adds a new cooking recipe: Sweet Gem Parfait,
The recipe for Sweet Gem Parfait can be purchased at Krobus's shop in the sewers.

Adds a new way to obtain rare seeds:
By offering 25 sugar to the new Old Master's Shrine you will obtain a rare seed.
The recipe for the Old Master's Shrine can be purchased at Krobus's shop in the sewers.[/spoiler]
[/code]
